note: Source base 1d893ccc507bea94c62e5a0d79d3374521702acc. Approved plan body f043b1261ec6. Normal format passed with zero original tracked-file changes. An initial legacy-deploy command failed before resolution with ERR_PNPM_UNUSED_PATCH and earns no product red credit. Offline, production-only, frozen lock and ignored lifecycle-script options were retained; no patch or workspace setting was changed.
